title: A Birthday Party
description: A girl has a birthday party with her friends.
instructions: Read the text about a birthday party, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Last Sunday was Anna's birthday. She was nine years old. She had a party at her house with eight friends.
Anna's mum made a big chocolate cake. There were nine candles on it. Everyone sang 'Happy Birthday' and Anna blew out the candles.
Her friends gave her many presents. Her best friend, Jack, gave her a blue bicycle. Anna was very glad. It was the best day of the year for her.

After the cake, the children played games in the garden. They played hide and seek. Tom hid behind a big tree. Nobody found him for ten minutes. Then they had a race. Lucy was the fastest, and she won a small toy car.

At four o'clock, it started to rain. The children ran inside the house. Anna's dad put on some music. Everyone danced in the living room. Anna's little brother, Ben, danced too. He was only three, and he fell down many times. Everyone laughed.
At six o'clock, the parents came to take the children home. Anna said goodbye to her friends at the door. She gave each friend a small bag of sweets. 'Thank you for coming,' she said.
That night, Anna was very tired. She looked at her presents again. Then she went to bed. She wanted to ride her new bicycle the next morning. She closed her eyes and smiled.
